newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best says Fremont unit under review.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best says Fremont unit under review.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said on Tuesday it was reviewing Fremont Compensation Insurance Group's "A-", or excellent, ratings, with developing implications.
In addition, A.M. Best said, it was also reviewing the "A" ratings of the Industrial Indemnity Insurance Group, with negative implications.

The rating actions follow Fremont General Corp's announcement that it had entered into a definitive agreement to purchase Industrial Indemnity Holdings Inc from Talegen Holdings Inc for $365 million in cash.
In addition, Fremont will repay Industrial Indemnity's $79 million outstanding debt obligation to Talegen, A.M. Best said in a statement.

"A.M. Best is concerned about Fremont's ability to effectively administer and integrate the combined operations given the new territories and insureds, as well as the fact that this large transaction follows closely behind its substantial acquisition of Casualty Insurance Co in 1995," the insurance rating company said.
In addition, A.M. Best said, the transaction weakens Fremont's capitalization.
Upon close of the transaction, A.M. Best said it anticipates lowering Industrial Indemnity's rating to reflect its affiliation with the lower rated Fremont.
The acquisition is expected to close in the third quarter of 1997.
